title: Luxuriant Australian Chicken Tagine
description: A jammy and creamy Australian dish featuring tarragon leaves, this kid-friendly chicken tagine is a high-protein delight, cooked to perfection in a traditional tagine pot. The combination of flavors and textures creates a truly unique culinary experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken pieces with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken pieces to the pot and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth, heavy cream, dried apricots, and tarragon leaves to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Cook the tagine for 25 minutes, then remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shock the cooked chicken in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional tarragon leaves if desired.
